title: Set up monitoring & alerting (Cloud Monitoring + Grafana)
description: Configure Cloud Monitoring metrics: API latency, error rate, job duration. Create Grafana dashboard. Set up alerts: error rate >5%, latency p95 >1s, job failures.

title: Set up CI/CD pipeline (GitHub Actions)
description: Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml. Stages: lint, test, build Docker, deploy to staging, run smoke tests. Trigger on push to main. Manual approval for production.

title: Write unit tests for RMAB algorithms (clustering, Whittle)
description: Test clustering with synthetic data (silhouette score ≥0.6). Test Whittle solver properties (index_U > index_R). Test MDP parameter validation. Target: 80% coverage.

title: Create synthetic data generator for testing
description: Generate 10K synthetic caregivers with realistic engagement patterns. Use for validating clustering, MDP learning, Whittle solver before real data.

title: Prepare Week 8 results report (for stakeholders)
description: Create presentation: A/B test results, cost analysis, lessons learned, next steps. Include graphs: vaccination rates, engagement trends, cost breakdown.

title: Implement /precompute_indices endpoint (Whittle solver API)
description: POST endpoint to compute and cache Whittle indices. Store in PostgreSQL and Redis. Return model_version for tracking.

title: Add rate limiting (per-endpoint limits)
description: Use slowapi or similar. Limits: /recommend=100/min, /update_state=1000/min, /train_*=1/hour. Return 429 with Retry-After header.

title: Train Suvita team on dashboard and API usage
description: 30-minute training session. Cover: dashboard interpretation, how to trigger manual training, CSV export process. Record session for reference.

title: Implement /assign_cluster endpoint (FO mapper API)
description: POST endpoint for cold-start cluster assignment. Use FO mapper (demographics → cluster_id). Set warmup_end_date = enrollment + 6 weeks.

title: Deploy to production Cloud Run
description: Promote staging deployment to production. Update DNS if needed. Configure production API keys. Monitor logs for first 1 hour. Have rollback plan ready.

title: Containerize FastAPI service (Docker multi-stage build)
description: Create Dockerfile with Python 3.10 base. Multi-stage build for smaller image. Install dependencies, copy source code. Build job runner variant for Cloud Run Jobs.

title: Create operational runbooks (incident response)
description: Document procedures: rollback deployment, cancel stuck jobs, clear Redis cache, restart Cloud Run instances. Store in docs/runbooks/.

title: MVP Implementation: Bandicoot RMAB System
description: 6-8 week MVP to deploy RMAB-based vaccination adherence system for Suvita (200K caregivers). Target: 20-26% improvement in vaccination completion. Proven approach based on SAHELI (Google/ARMMAN). Budget: <$200/month infrastructure.

title: Phase 0: Library Development (Week 1-2)
description: Build standalone Python library that can run locally with CSV data, be validated in Jupyter notebooks, and later be wrapped by the FastAPI service. Enable rapid experimentation without cloud deployment.

title: Set up bandicoot/ package structure with setup.py
description: Create bandicoot/ directory with core/, data/, models/, utils/ subdirectories. Add __init__.py files. Create setup.py for pip install -e . with dependencies: numpy, pandas, scikit-learn, bayesianbandits.

title: Implement bandicoot/utils/visualization.py (plotting helpers)
description: Plotting functions for Jupyter notebooks: cluster visualization (t-SNE), MDP transition diagrams, Whittle index distributions, recommendation quality charts using matplotlib/seaborn.

title: Write unit tests for library (pytest, ≥80% coverage)
description: Test all core modules: clustering (silhouette score), MDP (transition probabilities), Whittle (index properties), recommender (end-to-end). Use synthetic data generator. Target: 80% coverage.

title: Create experiments/ folder with 6 Jupyter notebooks (.py format)
description: Set up experiments/ directory. Create 6 notebooks as .py files (for version control): 01_data_exploration.py, 02_clustering_validation.py, 03_mdp_learning.py, 04_whittle_computation.py, 05_recommendation_test.py, 06_ab_test_simulation.py. Use Jupyter cell markers (# %%).

title: Implement experiment 01_data_exploration.py (EDA)
description: Exploratory data analysis on Suvita data. Load CSV, analyze distributions (engagement rates, vaccination rates, demographics), identify data quality issues, visualize patterns.

title: Implement experiment 02_clustering_validation.py
description: Test clustering with different k values (15-26). Compare silhouette scores, analyze cluster characteristics (size, engagement, vaccination rates), visualize with t-SNE.

title: Implement experiment 03_mdp_learning.py
description: Test MDP parameter learning on historical data. Estimate P(s'|s,a) and rewards per cluster. Validate transition probability constraints. Analyze parameter distributions across clusters.

title: Implement experiment 04_whittle_computation.py
description: Test Whittle index computation. Analyze index distributions, verify index_U > index_R property, measure computation time per cluster-state, identify numerical stability issues.

title: Implement experiment 05_recommendation_test.py (end-to-end)
description: End-to-end test on Suvita data. Run complete pipeline: fit on historical data, generate recommendations with budget=1000, validate output quality, check monotonicity of priority scores.

title: Implement experiment 06_ab_test_simulation.py
description: Simulate A/B test outcomes. Compare RMAB vs random/heuristic selection. Estimate expected improvement in vaccination rates. Analyze statistical significance and sample size requirements.

title: Create synthetic data generator (bandicoot/data/synthetic.py)
description: Generate 10K synthetic caregivers with realistic engagement patterns for testing. Include demographics, SMS engagement history, vaccination outcomes. Parameterize cluster behaviors (responsive vs unresponsive).

title: Implement bandicoot/core/clustering.py (ClusteringEngine)
description: Implement K-means clustering on passive transition probabilities. Extract features from historical data, run k-means with k=15-25, compute silhouette score for validation. Target: ≥70% cluster quality.

title: Document library API (README + docstrings)
description: Write bandicoot/README.md with installation, quick start, API reference. Add docstrings to all public classes/methods. Document CSV schema requirements and expected outputs.

title: Validate library on synthetic data
description: Run complete pipeline on synthetic data. Verify clustering quality, MDP parameters, Whittle indices, recommendations. Ensure no errors/warnings. Benchmark performance.

title: Test library with Suvita sample data (10K caregivers)
description: Obtain 10K caregiver sample from Suvita (6 months historical). Run library on real data. Validate cluster quality, analyze recommendations, share results with stakeholders. Debug data quality issues.

title: Implement bandicoot/core/mdp.py (MDP parameter learning)
description: Use bayesianbandits library (DirichletClassifier) to learn P(s'|s,a) and P(R|s,a) per cluster. Validate transition probabilities sum to 1.0. Handle sparse data edge cases.

title: Implement bandicoot/core/whittle.py (Whittle index solver)
description: Implement binary search + value iteration algorithm. Add numerical stability checks (NaN/Inf detection). Target: <10s per cluster-state pair. Critical algorithm for prioritization.

title: Implement bandicoot/core/fo_mapper.py (Features-Only mapper)
description: Train RandomForest classifier: demographics → cluster_id for cold-start problem. Target: ≥70% accuracy on validation set. Use scikit-learn with cross-validation.

title: Implement bandicoot/core/recommender.py (BandicootRMAB)
description: Main library class with fit(), recommend(), and evaluate() methods. Orchestrates clustering, MDP learning, Whittle computation. Pure Python, no database dependencies.

title: Implement bandicoot/data/loaders.py (CSV/DataFrame loaders)
description: Load historical data from CSV files. Parse caregiver_id, sms_sent, sms_delivered, sms_opened, vaccinated, state transitions. Validate schema and data quality.

title: Implement bandicoot/data/preprocessors.py (data transformation)
description: Clean and transform raw data. Handle missing values, extract features (passive transition probabilities, demographics), prepare for clustering and MDP learning.

title: Implement bandicoot/utils/metrics.py (evaluation metrics)
description: Evaluation functions: precision_at_k, recall_at_k, NDCG. Compare recommendations against ground truth vaccination outcomes. Support A/B test analysis.

title: Run first training job on real Suvita data
description: Trigger /train_clusters with real historical data. Validate cluster quality, MDP parameters, Whittle indices. Debug any data quality issues. Target: k=18-22 clusters.

title: Write integration tests (API endpoints with real DB)
description: Test all endpoints with pytest. Use testcontainers for PostgreSQL/Redis. Validate: /recommend returns 1000 items, /train_clusters creates clusters, /update_state syncs cache.

title: Assign 1,000 caregivers to A/B test (500 treatment, 500 control)
description: Use stratified randomization. Treatment: RMAB-prioritized. Control: random selection. Balance by district, age, parity. Document assignments in database.

title: Implement initial data load ETL (6 months historical)
description: Extract SMS logs, demographics, vaccination records from Suvita. Transform to (state, action, reward) format. Load to Bandicoot training_data table. ~10K caregivers for pilot.

title: Conduct load testing (/recommend with 200K caregivers)
description: Use Locust or k6. Simulate 100 concurrent requests to /recommend. Measure p50, p95, p99 latency. Target: p95 <500ms. Identify bottlenecks (Redis, PostgreSQL).

title: Generate first daily recommendations for Suvita
description: Call /recommend with budget=1000. Export to CSV for Suvita's SMS system. Verify: priorities make sense, no duplicate caregivers, all in treatment group.

title: Connect to Suvita PostgreSQL (read-only replica)
description: Get database credentials, VPN access. Test connection to sms_logs, caregivers, vaccinations tables. Implement connection pooling.

title: Run first production training job
description: Trigger weekly_training Cloud Function. Monitor job duration, resource usage. Validate clusters, indices cached in Redis. Check for errors in Cloud Logging.

title: Phase 3: Deployment, Testing & Monitoring
description: Week 5-6: Deploy to Cloud Run, set up monitoring, implement A/B testing framework, conduct load tests. Prepare for production launch.

title: Set up PostgreSQL schemas (clusters, caregiver_states, whittle_indices)
description: Create tables per docs/tech-design/01-data-architecture.md. Include indexes for performance. Test with synthetic data.

title: Plan Phase 2 (scale to 50K caregivers)
description: Based on MVP learnings, design scale-up plan. Address: performance bottlenecks, cost optimization, additional features (multi-channel, fairness constraints).

title: Set up Redis cache structure and eviction policies
description: Configure Redis for Whittle index caching. Set up key patterns (whittle:{cluster}:{state}). Configure volatile-lru eviction.

title: Add API authentication (API key-based)
description: Implement Bearer token authentication. Store API keys in Secret Manager. Add middleware to verify on all endpoints except /health.

title: Set up Cloud Functions for batch jobs (nightly, weekly)
description: Create 2 Cloud Functions: nightly_state_update (01:00 daily), weekly_training (02:00 Sunday). Configure Cloud Scheduler triggers. Test manual invocation.

title: Monitor A/B test metrics (Week 7-8)
description: Track: vaccination completion rate (treatment vs control), SMS open rate, time to vaccination. Daily check for first week, then weekly. Target: ≥10% improvement.

title: Phase 2: API Development & Suvita Integration
description: Week 3-4: Build FastAPI service, implement endpoints, integrate with Suvita's PostgreSQL. Run training on real historical data.

title: Implement Features-Only (FO) mapper (RandomForest)
description: Train classifier: demographics → cluster_id. Target: ≥70% accuracy on validation set. Use scikit-learn RandomForestClassifier with cross-validation.

title: Implement Whittle index solver (binary search + value iteration)
description: Critical algorithm. Implement per docs/tech-design/02-rmab-core.md. Add numerical stability checks (NaN/Inf detection). Target: <10s per cluster-state pair.

title: Phase 4: Production Launch & Monitoring
description: Week 7-8: Launch A/B test with 1,000 caregivers, monitor metrics, fix bugs, tune parameters. Prepare for scale-up.

title: Implement clustering algorithm (k-means on passive features)
description: Per docs/tech-design/02-rmab-core.md: extract passive transition probabilities, run k-means with k=15-25, use silhouette score. Target: 70%+ cluster quality.

title: Phase 1: Core Infrastructure & Algorithms
description: Week 1-2: Implement core RMAB algorithms, database schemas, and job execution framework. No external integrations yet - focus on getting the math right.

title: Configure IAM permissions (service accounts, API keys)
description: Create service accounts: bandicoot-api, bandicoot-jobs. Grant minimal permissions (Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager). Generate API keys for Suvita.

title: Fix production bugs and tune parameters
description: Address issues discovered in production. Common: cluster count tuning (k=15-25), Whittle solver timeouts, Redis cache misses. Prioritize by impact.

title: Set up FastAPI service skeleton with OpenAPI docs
description: Create src/api/ structure. Configure CORS, request validation (Pydantic), error handling. Generate Swagger UI at /docs.

title: Implement A/B test framework (randomization + tracking)
description: Add ab_test_group column to caregiver_states. Implement stratified randomization (by district, age). Track outcomes separately. Create /abtest API for status.

title: Implement /train_clusters endpoint (batch training API)
description: POST endpoint to trigger clustering + MDP learning. Use JobExecutor abstraction. Return job_id for status tracking. Max timeout: 60 minutes.

title: Integrate bayesianbandits library for MDP parameter learning
description: Implement DirichletClassifier for learning P(s'|s,a) and P(R|s,a) per cluster. Validate transition probabilities sum to 1.0.

title: Implement /update_state endpoint (bulk state updates)
description: POST endpoint to update caregiver states (Responsive/Unresponsive). Support bulk updates for nightly ETL. Sync to Redis cache.

title: Deploy to Cloud Run (staging environment)
description: Deploy container to Cloud Run. Configure minScale=1 (avoid cold starts), maxScale=10. Set environment variables (DB_URL, REDIS_URL, API_KEY). Test with curl.

title: Implement job execution abstraction (JobExecutor interface)
description: Per docs/tech-design/06-job-execution.md: create abstract JobExecutor class, CloudRunJobsExecutor implementation, factory pattern. Support GCP Cloud Run Jobs.

title: Implement /recommend endpoint (main prioritization API)
description: GET endpoint with ?budget=K parameter. Return top-K caregivers ranked by Whittle index. Target: <500ms p95 latency. Support filters (district, AB test group).
